trades.name: YETI
trades.why: Guide cut on weaker US demand with the CEO flagging Q4 pressure; broke the 20-day low on 4.9x volume inside a downtrend, with analyst cuts still to come and retail reports next week.
trades.wrong_if: Two or more brokers raise targets or upgrade on the margin story; the company announces an accelerated buyback; or the retail reports (retail sales and Home Depot 11-17, TJX and Lowe's 11-18, Walmart 11-19) describe improving discretionary demand and YETI regains 40.47.
